title: Smiling Parents Holding Bundled Baby Outdoors, c. 1970 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot capturing a joyful family posing outdoors in an autumn park setting. A smiling father wearing thick-rimmed eyeglasses and a dark blazer stands next to a radiant mother with styled hair wearing a belted trench coat over a turtleneck. Between them, they cradle a young baby bundled warmly in a white hooded snowsuit against the backdrop of large tree trunks.
